raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: subversion
  version: "1.15.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://downloads.apache.org/subversion/subversion-${{ version }}.tar.bz2
  sha256: dfb7b1e5270c7def971ccbd5938b0c03b1b5bd60b6674a2d8a74a9560839fb8c

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win or ppc64le

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - gettext-tools
    - make
    - nasm
    - python
    - perl
    - swig >=4.0,<4.4
    - if: unix
      then:
        - autoconf
        - automake
        - pkg-config
  host:
    - expat
    - libapr
    - libaprutil
    - libboost-headers
    - libdb
    - libutf8proc
    - lz4-c
    - openssl
    - perl
    - serf
    - sqlite
    - zlib 
    - if: unix
      then: 
        - cyrus-sasl
        - gnupg
        - libtool
        - libmagic
    - if: not linux
      then: libintl-devel
  run:
    - perl

tests:
  - script:
      - svn --help
      - find $PREFIX/lib/perl5 -name "*.pm" -path "*/SVN/*" || echo "No SVN .pm files found under $PREFIX/lib/perl5"
      - find $PREFIX/lib -name "Client.pm" -path "*/SVN/*" || echo "No SVN Client.pm found under $PREFIX/lib"
      - perl -MConfig -e 'print "sitelib=$Config{installsitelib}\nsitearch=$Config{installsitearch}\n"'
      - perl -e 'use SVN::Client; use SVN::Core;'

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Enterprise-class centralized version control for the masses
  homepage: https://subversion.apache.org/
  repository: https://subversion.apache.org/source-code.html
  documentation: https://subversion.apache.org/docs/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
    - scopatz
    - zklaus
    - rfiorella
